question: Which of the following inflammatory mediators exerts a synergistic effect with prostglandin E2 (PGE2) in the increase of vascular permeability ?:
analysis: Leukotriene B4 (LTB4) is known to have a synergistic effect with prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) in increasing vascular permeability. Both mediators play significant roles in the inflammatory response, and their combined action enhances the permeability of blood vessels, facilitating the movement of immune cells to sites of inflammation.
